row.evidence: JustCall's own SSO guides (Business plan only) state: "User provisioning is currently not supported, i.e., a user created in Okta needs to be created in JustCall as well and then authenticated via Okta before logging in to JustCall."
row.notes: No SCIM on any tier. Every JustCall SSO guide (Okta, Entra/Azure, Google, OneLogin, JumpCloud) says SSO is Business-plan only and that user provisioning is not supported; users must already exist in JustCall (no JIT: SAML only matches existing users by email). Business is custom-priced with a 10-license minimum and lists Single sign-on; Team $29, Pro $49 and Pro Plus $89 per user/month billed annually (2-license minimum). June prices for Team unchanged. The public REST API v2.1 (from Team) can list/get users and manage user groups but has no create, invite or delete user endpoint, so IdP API provisioning is not possible either. Members are added by invite (individually or CSV) and removed manually in the web portal.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks are available from Team (c35) but the documented event groups are call, SMS/WhatsApp, contact and scheduled-task events; no user lifecycle events found.

rate_limits.text: Team: 1,800 requests/hour, 30/minute burst; Pro and Pro Plus: 3,600/hour, 60/minute; Business and SalesPro: 5,400/hour, 90/minute

limitations.text: No user create, invite or delete endpoints in the public API; user lifecycle is manual in the web portal.

entra.notes: JustCall's guide uses a non-gallery 'create your own application' SAML app.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin.

onelogin.notes: JustCall's guide uses OneLogin's generic SAML Test Connector.

jumpcloud.notes: JustCall's guide searches for a JustCall app in JumpCloud's SSO catalogue.

fallbacks.notes: SAML signs in only users that already exist (matched by email); bulk invite by CSV of email addresses.
